title: The regions BED targets coordinates the reference slice does not cover
next_step: STRhub's reference BAM is a slice over forensic STR loci, not a whole genome, so a tool aimed outside it would find no reads and look broken through no fault of its own. Download the supported-loci panel for your input type and rebuild your BED within those windows, then re-submit. Re-verification is free.
